description: Get the full directory entry for one MCP server by id ('owner--repo', e.g. 'microsoft--playwright-mcp'). Includes install hint, license, stars, category, and editorial fields. An install_hint appears only when the package's registry entry names the listed repository; that is an identity check, not a security review: relay the install_hint_caveat with it rather than presenting it as ready to run.
name: get_server
